answer.summary: The TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest ArchUnit rule fails deterministically. AtomicTestingService now has an AssetAgentJobRepository field and calls deleteAllByInjectIdsAndTenantId from stop(), and that access is not on the allowed list. The change caused this, so a rerun will fail the same way. The Jackson parse error and exception dumps earlier in the log are unrelated noise.
